panel.title: 切り替えやすいAPIキーとモデルIDのグループ
panel.subtitle: Save your API accounts here and switch them with an explicit apply.
panel.emptyHelp: Create a blank preset, start from current N.E.K.O API settings, or choose a saved preset to copy. Enter your own API keys.
panel.name: プリセット名
panel.builtinHelp: Manage keys in the API key book below. Built-in endpoints and models remain managed by N.E.K.O.
panel.keySaved: Saved key · leave unchanged to keep
panel.optionalKey: Optional for a local service that does not require authentication.
panel.customHelp: Unconfigured slots return to their follow mode on every apply; image generation defaults to disabled.
panel.urlHelp: http/https; no credentials or query parameters in the URL.
panel.wsHelp: ws/wss; requires a realtime backend implemented by N.E.K.O.
panel.httpsHelp: https only; requires a compatible image generation endpoint.
panel.specialHelp: Changing the endpoint does not add backend support. TTS also depends on compatible voice settings in N.E.K.O.
panel.followHelp: Use the followed API. No custom endpoint, model or key is stored for this slot.
panel.imageOff: Image generation is disabled in this preset.
panel.saveFirst: Save changes before applying. Saving alone does not change N.E.K.O.
panel.discard: Discard the unsaved changes in this editor?
panel.deleteConfirm: Delete preset “{name}”? This deletes its saved keys from the plugin and leaves N.E.K.O unchanged.
panel.applyScope: Apply updates both APIs and every model slot; previous custom slots are reset. Active conversations may end.
panel.applyConfirm: Apply “{name}”? This updates core/assist APIs and keys, replaces custom slots, resets other slots to follow (image disabled), and turns off the old Token Plan / GPT-SoVITS flags. Active conversations may end. The plugin does not submit character voice settings.
panel.copied: Independent copy created. You can rename it below.
panel.applied: N.E.K.O confirmed that the configuration was applied.
panel.failed: Operation failed. Try again after refreshing the panel.
panel.lastSuccess: Last successful apply: {name} · {time}. This is a record, not the current N.E.K.O configuration.
panel.lastUnknown: Last apply not confirmed: {name} · {time}. N.E.K.O may have saved it; check before applying again.
errors.invalid_key: Invalid key: use a real printable API key, not a masked value.
errors.missing_saved_key: No saved key exists for that field.
errors.invalid_url: Invalid endpoint URL. Check the scheme; remove credentials, query parameters and fragments.
errors.invalid_model: Enter a valid model ID (up to 200 characters).
errors.invalid_notes: Notes must be at most 2000 characters.
errors.invalid_follow: That follow mode is not supported for this slot.
errors.unsupported_provider: This N.E.K.O version does not support a saved provider. Edit the preset.
errors.unsupported_slot_provider: This N.E.K.O version does not support a saved model route. Edit the preset.
errors.required_key: Enter keys for both selected non-free core and assist providers.
errors.duplicate_name: A preset with this name already exists.
errors.not_found: The preset was deleted. Reopen the panel.
errors.conflict: This preset changed in another window. Reopen the panel before editing or applying.
errors.invalid_storage: Invalid plugin data. The existing file has not been replaced.
errors.storage_limit: Plugin data exceeds the 2 MiB limit.
errors.storage_failed: Could not write plugin data. Check disk space and permissions.
errors.metadata_failed: N.E.K.O provider metadata is unavailable or incompatible.
errors.invalid_port: Plugin main_server_port must be an integer from 1 to 65535 (0 for automatic).
errors.host_unavailable: Cannot connect to N.E.K.O. Check that the main server is running and the plugin port is correct.
errors.host_timeout: N.E.K.O request timed out. Apply may have saved; check its state before retrying.
errors.host_rejected: N.E.K.O rejected this configuration. Check providers and custom model settings.
errors.saved_reload_failed: N.E.K.O saved the settings but could not reload. Check N.E.K.O before retrying.
errors.busy: Another plugin operation is running. Try again when it finishes.
errors.internal: Operation failed. Reopen the panel and try again.
panel.imported: Current N.E.K.O API settings loaded into a new draft.
panel.importHelp: プロバイダー、カスタムモデル設定と有効状態を取り込みます。Key は手動で入力し、名前を付けて保存してください。N.E.K.O はまだ変更されていません。
panel.importSkipped: Unsupported slot selections were reset to their default follow mode (image disabled): {slots}. Check them before saving.
panel.keyBookHelp: Manage keys for all built-in providers in this preset, including providers not currently selected. Core and assist APIs use the matching key from this book. Keys stay independent between presets.
panel.keyBookUnavailable: Provider metadata is unavailable. Reconnect to list all providers.
probe.title: API connectivity
probe.help: Tests run after saving. Hover or focus a light for its functions and model. Shared configurations are tested once per round.
probe.finished: Connectivity tests finished. Check the lights for results.
probe.savedTested: Preset saved to the plugin. Connectivity tests finished; check the lights for results.
probe.savedTestFailed: Preset saved to the plugin, but connectivity testing could not finish. You can retry testing.
probe.failed: Connectivity testing could not finish. Retry testing; the saved preset is retained.
probe.status.untested: Not tested (save or test this preset)
probe.note.unsupported: N.E.K.O has no matching probe for this configuration.
probe.note.disabled: This function is disabled in the preset.
probe.note.voice_required: Built-in TTS / GPT-SoVITS needs character voice settings. This plugin does not import voices; no speech test was sent.
probe.note.credential_only: This core provider is checked via its text endpoint. Success verifies the key, not realtime voice.
probe.note.default_voice: Speech endpoint tested with N.E.K.O's default test voice; this does not verify the character's voice.
probe.error.connection_refused: Could not connect to the API.
probe.error.backend_unavailable: N.E.K.O's testing endpoint is unavailable or returned an invalid response.
vendors.name: Provider name
vendors.saveHelp: プロバイダーと現在のプリセットの変更を保存します。N.E.K.O には適用しません。
vendors.removeConfirm: Delete this provider from the current preset?
vendors.inUse: A model uses this provider. Switch or reset that model before deleting it.
vendors.addHelp: Add a provider to this preset (up to 32)
vendors.testHelp: Enter a name, URL and key, then select this provider for a model and enter its model ID. Saving tests selected models; unused providers send no requests.
vendors.linked: URL and key come from this preset's API book. Edit them in the book.
errors.vendor_limit: Each preset supports up to 32 added providers.
errors.invalid_vendor: Provider names must be non-empty and unique. Check the provider and its model references.
panel.customEnabled: カスタム API を有効にする
panel.customEnabledHelp: オフにしても入力内容は保持され、適用時もオフのままです。GPT-SoVITS は本体の独立した有効化方式に従います。
